description:
Read-only SQL over a dataset's own tables (one SELECT/WITH statement; every table name is a view
    over that dataset's own files — nothing else on the server is reachable this way).

    Args:
        dataset_id: from a prior generate_dataset call.
        sql:        a single SELECT (or WITH ... SELECT) statement. No semicolons, file paths, or
                    statements that write or read outside the dataset (checked before running).
        limit:      rows returned (capped at 5000).

    Returns:
        columns, rows, truncated (whether more rows existed than `limit`).
name: query_dataset
title: Query a dataset with SQL
